title: Human Anatomy I: Terminology, Osteology and Body Systems

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Proximal?
o: a tiny air sac of the lung where gas exchange takes place
a vertical plane that divides the body into left and right parts
the directional term meaning nearer to the point where a limb joins the trunk
a large branch of the trachea that carries air into a lung
items.s: Proximal: the directional term meaning nearer to the point where a limb joins the trunk. The other options describe Bronchus, Sagittal plane, Alveolus.

items.q: Which term is described by “the movement of a limb away from the midline of the body”?
o: Origin
Extension
Adduction
Abduction
items.s: Abduction is the movement of a limb away from the midline of the body.

items.q: Ligament may be defined as
o: the upper chamber of the heart that receives blood from the veins
the dense hard bone tissue that forms the outer shell of bones
a band of fibrous tissue that joins one bone to another
the part of the body made up of the limbs and their girdles
items.s: Ligament: a band of fibrous tissue that joins one bone to another. The other options describe Appendicular region, Atrium, Compact bone.

items.q: The statement “a tiny air sac of the lung where gas exchange takes place” describes which of the following?

Trachea

items.s: Alveolus is a tiny air sac of the lung where gas exchange takes place.

items.q: Articulation may be defined as
o: a cut made along the long axis of an organ or structure
the directional term meaning nearer to the feet or lower end
the movement of a limb toward the midline of the body
the point where two or more bones meet and are joined
items.s: Articulation: the point where two or more bones meet and are joined. The other options describe Inferior, Adduction, Longitudinal section.

items.q: The statement “the circuit that carries blood from the heart to the body and back” describes which of the following?

items.s: Systemic circulation is the circuit that carries blood from the heart to the body and back.

items.q: Synapse may be defined as

items.s: Synapse: the junction at which one neuron passes a signal to another cell. The other options describe Pulmonary circulation, Axial region, Insertion.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Osteology.

items.s: Osteology: the branch of anatomy that studies the structure and function of bones. The other options describe Medial, Abdominal cavity, Anterior.
